Our Physiotherapy Services at Physio Therapy Singapore Collective

Specialised care plans designed by Physio Therapy Singapore Collective to enhance your mobility, strength, and overall well-being.

View All

✦

Musculoskeletal (General)

Our physiotherapists focus on treating muscle, joint, and movement-related pain caused by injury, strain, or daily stress. They use a combination of hands-on therapy, corrective exercises, and modern techniques to design treatment plans that restore mobility, strength, and functional movement.

Women’s Health (through Life Stages)

Our women’s health physiotherapists provide specialized care for pain, pelvic floor dysfunction, and body changes across all life stages. Through targeted therapy, guided exercises, and personalised support, we help improve comfort, strength, and overall quality of life.

Lymphatics – Dysfunction & Optimisation

Our therapists offer focused lymphatic care to support fluid balance, reduce swelling, and improve circulation. Using gentle manual techniques and therapeutic strategies, treatment is tailored to enhance recovery, support healing, and optimize lymphatic system function.

Scar Rehabilitation

Our scar rehabilitation therapy helps reduce pain, stiffness, and restriction caused by surgical or injury-related scars. Through specialized hands-on techniques and guided movement therapy, we support healthy tissue healing, improved mobility, and long-term functional recovery.

Gentle, Expert Care Through Pregnancy & Beyond

Pre-natal & post-natal physiotherapy, massage and fitness to support your body and calm your mind.


Pregnancy and early motherhood bring big changes, and you deserve warm, personal support. Our prenatal and postnatal physiotherapy, massage, and training services keep you comfortable, confident, and cared-for. You can visit our clinic, conveniently located at Telok Ayer, or choose to receive care at home, with flexible options designed around your well-being.


For our complete range of specialised maternity services, please visit Health2Mama.

Make An Enquiry

Physiotherapy at Home or in Clinic in Singapore

We believe that healthcare should be as unique as you are. That’s why Physio Therapy Singapore Collective offers personalized therapy services that cater to your specific needs, whether you’re looking for Pain Relief, Improved Mobility, Strengthening, Recovery After Surgery or Sports Injuries, Massage, Personal Training, or Pregnancy & After Birth Care.


All of our therapists, including AHPC Registered Physiotherapists and Occupational Therapists, specialize in their respective fields and bring years of experience to the services they provide at Physio Therapy Singapore Collective.

Meet Our Trusted Physiotherapists and Wellness Experts

Behind every session at Physio Therapy Singapore Collective is a therapist who truly cares. They are here not just to treat but to listen, support, and help you feel confident in your body again.
